messages:
Emily P.: Quick sync — we need to finalize MDF allocations for partner tiers and lock capacity for the SI onboarding wave. I dropped the working sheet here: https://tiny.redwood/mdf-q3-forecast. Can people confirm numbers by EOD Fri?
Nate S.: Quick Q — is the marketplace pilot budget coming from MDF or co-invest?
Emily P.: Marketplace pilots should come from MDF pilot bucket (line 7 in the sheet). Co-invest only for HW credits.
Lucy M.: Got it. Marketing will earmark comms spend but need final MDF amounts to book creative. Can we get a confirmed folder + PO by Monday?
Jordan O.: Ops note: Dedicated capacity for the SI pilots needs a commit of at least 6 reserved GPUs for 6 weeks per SI. If partners want bursts, we should budget a 20% buffer.
Kai E.: From infra: request details we need: expected QPS, avg seq len, model family. We can populate a quick perf profile once we have that.
Nate S.: For SI onboards — can we require a short enablement workshop (2 hrs) and a test integration with our SDK? That will reduce runtime surprises.
Emily P.: Agree. Action: Jordan to spin up onboarding checklist, Kai to make perf profile template, Lucy to reserve marketing slots. I'll update the sheet with draft numbers tonight.
Jordan O.: Onboarding checklist draft:
```
- Intro call + NDA
- Tech discovery (QPS, models, data residency)
- SDK test + sample workload
- Capacity reservation + burst policy
- Go/no-go QBR slot 
```
Jordan O.: I'll post the checklist in the shared drive by EOD.
partners-bot: Reminder: QBR nominations open — deadline 3 days. See /qbr command.
Lucy M.: Heads up — if we push content earlier we can align with partner HW announcement window (week of 5/10). Need MDF approve by 5/3 to keep that.
Nate S.: Can partners increase MDF if they show early traction? what's the process?
Emily P.: Yes, there is a reallocation window. Submit an MDF increase request in the sheet and tag me + finance. We'll triage weekly.
Kai E.: For perf profiling, link to template: https://tiny.redwood/perf-template. I can run baseline tests once SI provides sample prompt set.
Emily P.: OK — Owners: Jordan (onboard checklist), Kai (perf template + baseline), Lucy (marketing booking), Nate (SI commit confirmation). Please update the sheet by Fri noon. I'll schedule a 30m sync on Fri 11am to close.
Nate S.: Noted, will reach out to SI leads today.
Lucy M.: Will block time for messaging review.
Jordan O.: I'll ping infra if any GPU exceptions are needed.
Emily P.: Thanks — small ask: tag your row in the sheet with your initials so I can track approvals. :thumbsup:
